The plate is a long, boat-shaped dish, roughly 25 cm across its long dimension. The cauliflower florets cover about 10 cm by 5 cm in the middle of it.

I count about 4 small to medium florets, which I estimate at 15-25 g each, so about 80 g in total.

A second plate in the corner holds corn on the cob pieces. They are only partly visible, and I estimate them at about 80 g. I'm counting them as a separate item because they sit on a different plate, but they are probably part of the meal.
